title: Sunday Sketch

selected_categories.reasoning: The core mechanic is choosing between branching dialogue responses that directly determine which path and ending the player receives.
The experience is primarily a short dialogue-driven narrative presented with speaker labels, portraits, typewriter text, and scene-based progression.
Most player input is conversational response selection, even though the interface is staged like a visual novel rather than a messaging app.
The game models a small interpersonal decision about openness versus privacy, with alternate emotional outcomes based on social choices.
The story unfolds step-by-step through taps and scripted nodes, but there is no resource growth or true incremental meta progression.

uncertainty_notes: The game most closely resembles a compact visual novel, but that exact label is not available in the provided category universe.
Chat simulator is only a partial fit because the interaction is conversational, yet the presentation is not a phone-chat interface.
Incremental story game is a weak fifth-place fit chosen because the experience is heavily linear between decision points, not because it contains incremental progression systems.
